message.content: In the discussions regarding the future of the community garden, ChaeSong-hwa proposed an idea that resonated with many attendees. Specifically, ChaeSong-hwa suggested planning a little gathering in the garden once it is fully set up. This gathering was envisioned as a chance for everyone to come together, celebrate the efforts put into the garden, and enjoy the space they had created. ChaeSong-hwa mentioned that this could include fun games for children, flower planting workshops for all ages, and perhaps a potluck meal where people could share their favorite dishes. Additionally, the idea of having live music or some form of entertainment to enhance the experience was also discussed. Overall, ChaeSong-hwa's suggestion aimed to create a communal event that would strengthen the bond among the community members and make the garden truly a space for everyone to enjoy.
